Classic Bubble Bobble.name: Classic Bubble Bobble
Classic Bubble Bobble.summary: Classic Bubble Bobble is a remake of the original Bubble Bobble on the Game Boy Color platform.

Nations, The - Land of Legends.name: The Nations: Land of Legends
Nations, The - Land of Legends.summary: Since the dawn of time they have fought each other. Now as a vicious monster threatens their beautiful land, the Pimmons, Amazons and Sajikis must unite to overcome this terrible evil. Only be these three heroes working together can the fire breathing monster be defeated, but they need your help.

Opossum Country.name: Opossum Country
Opossum Country.summary: A story-driven horror game for Game Boy. Investigate a suspicious trailer park and uncover its secret horrors.
